rationale.hitl-workflow: Stakeholders approve requirement baselines, previews, and production deployments.
rationale.ai-review: AI-generated tests evaluate artifacts through the QA agent.
rationale.rules-based-checks: CI gates run tests, coverage thresholds, SAST, and DAST.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Preview environments let stakeholders inspect features before integration.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Versioned requirements, decision logs, and audit trails preserve reviewability.
